responsibility: Implements the pre-lexical source reader and normalizer for COBOL input, including source-format handling and copybook/directive expansion. It determines fixed/free/reference format, applies indicator-column and debug-line rules, strips or rewrites comments and continuations, mmap-reads files, recursively processes COPY and REPLACE/CDF directives into a single lexer stream annotated with file push/pop markers, and supplies the text transformation layer that feeds the Flex scanner.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual pre-lexing engine: source-format inference, line normalization, comment/continuation handling, and recursive COPY/REPLACE processing. The matching header only defines the data structures and entry points consumed by that engine and the lexer.
